credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Graphite sketch of a landscape. Simple line drawing, no shading. Abstracted form, moves the eye diagonally across the paper. Large, bulky form in the upper right hand corner of the paper tapers down to a narrow pathway at the bottom right of the paper.
title: Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)
